Name: Overgrown Flowery Interface Compatibility
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
UI retextures to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url] for a variety of popular QOL mods. Created primarily as a support file for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/collections/tjvl0j/revisions/53]Aesthetic Valley Fairycore [/url]collection, but shared here for everyone to use. 

[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]

[b][size=3]✧ Supported mods[/size][/b]
[color=#ff00ff]You do not need to use all of these![/color] Patches apply only when the target mod is installed. With Auto (default), compatibility turns on or off automatically if a mod is installed.
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384][b]Convenient Inventory[/b][/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505][b]Event Lookup[/b][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969][b]Fashion Sense[/b][/url] (Hand Mirror supported by CP)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17265][b]Unlockable Bundles[/b][/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369][b]Sword & Sorcery[/b][/url] [/*]
[/list][b][size=3]✧ Loose files (optional)[/size][/b]
Some mods may have graphics that cannot be replaced with Content Patcher. In those cases, loose files may be supplied.  
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969][/url][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11436]Deluxe Journal[/url] [/b](Tabs, animals, buildings)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969][b]Fashion Sense[/b][/url] (Clothing slot buttons for interface)[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7907]Quality Smash[/url][/b] (Inventory buttons) [/*]
[/list]These files are designed to work in Vortex too. When solving the conflict, please select either "After" for the loose files or "Before" for the original mod. 

[b][size=3]✧ Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.8.1+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166][b]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/b] by SugarSugarRun[/url].[/*]
[*]Install only the mods you actually use from the list above; unused sections stay inactive.[/*]
[/list][b][size=3]✧ Configuration[/size][/b]
Open GMCM, either through the Gear button in the bottom left of the title menu or Mod Options button at the bottom of in-game settings. Find [b]Overgrown Flowery Interface Compatibility[/b]. Each supported mod has [b]Auto[/b] or [b]Disable[/b], and may include other style options (like GMCM has various buttons!)  Choose Disable to skip a specific interface patch from this mod, which is useful if you want to mix-and-match this file with other replacers.

[b][size=3]✧ Credits[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]UI art based original interface by ConcernedApe and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Compatibility[/url] by Amaryn/Maraluna7/SugarSugarRun ([url=https://imgur.com/X3ldWJU]permission[/url]). [/*]
[*]UI elements from Deluxe Journal, Convenient Inventory, Event Lookup, Unlockable Bundles, Fashion Sense, Generic Mod Config Menu, Sword & Sorcery, and Quality Smash used within the bounds of those mods' recolor permission.[/*]
[*]The majority of the art files included are new recolors by JennaJuffuffles. [/*]
[/list][b]✧ Translators (Please Give Them Kudos!) ✧[/b]
[i]Since this mod only includes "auto", "disable" and mod names, I don't consider it a translation priority, but I'm always happy to be convinced otherwise. Send me your translation file via DM using [url=https://smapi.io/json/i18n/]https://smapi.io/json/i18n/[/url] to be considered for inclusion![/i]


[line]
